d: The Timberwolves defeated the Nets, 142-116 tonight in Minnesota. Jaden McDaniels contributed a team-high 34 points to go with 10 rebounds 6 assists and 4 three pointers, with Ayo Dosunmu of the Timberwolves adding an additional 23 points (8-13 FG, 4-7 3P) in the game. Julius Randle finished with a team-high 29 points along with 4 rebounds for the Nets in the losing effort. The Timberwolves improve their record to 13-5 with the win, while the Nets fall to 3-13 for the season.
